headline: Egypt Streamlines Industrial Building Permit Procedures Starting November
summary: The Industrial Development Authority is introducing a new mechanism with the Decennial Insurance Pool to simplify procedures and accelerate industrial building permits starting November 1, 2026.
why: Regulatory streamlining for industrial facilities aims to reduce administrative friction and encourage capital investment in manufacturing.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Regulatory changes affect the ease of doing business and industrial development timelines in the country.
